description: This is a generated Java class for registering Flutter plugins with an Android FlutterEngine. It systematically registers various plugins such as flutter_secure_storage, path_provider, shared_preferences, and sqflite by adding them to the FlutterEngine's plugin registry.

classes.name: GeneratedPluginRegistrant
classes.description: A utility class generated to automatically register Flutter plugins with the Android platform at runtime.

methods.name: registerWith
methods.description: Registers a set of Flutter plugins with the provided FlutterEngine instance, handling exceptions and logging errors if plugin registration fails.
